entry.name: ollamaUrl
entry.label: Base URL of the local Ollama HTTP server

entry.name: ollamaModel
entry.label: Default Ollama model name used for chat completions

entry.name: ollamaTemperature
entry.label: Sampling temperature (lower values reduce hallucination and increase grounding)

entry.name: ollamaNumCtx
entry.label: Context window token limit

entry.name: ollamaNumThread
entry.label: Number of CPU threads for inference (recommended: physical P-cores, e.g. 6)

entry.name: ollamaNumPredict
entry.label: Maximum tokens generated per turn

entry.name: ollamaKeepAlive
entry.label: Duration to keep model loaded in RAM between requests

entry.name: ollamaVisionModel
entry.label: Ollama vision model name (e.g. llama3.2:3b, llama3.2-vision, llava)

entry.name: systemPrompt
entry.label: System instructions provided to the AI assistant
entry.default: Eres Kity, un asistente de voz e inteligencia artificial nativo para KDE Plasma en CachyOS Linux. Responde SIEMPRE en español de España (castellano), de forma concisa, clara, directa y natural, optimizada para síntesis de voz (TTS).

entry.name: whisperModelPath
entry.label: Path to the whisper.cpp GGML model file (.bin). Leave empty to auto-detect in ~/.local/share/kity/models/

entry.name: whisperLanguage
entry.label: Speech recognition language code (e.g. es, en, auto)

entry.name: piperVoicePath
entry.label: Path to the Piper TTS ONNX model file (.onnx). Leave empty to auto-detect in ~/.local/share/kity/voices/

entry.name: panelIconStyle
entry.label: Visual style of the panel icon: symbolic (monochrome) or color

entry.name: speechOutputMode
entry.label: When Kity should read responses aloud: manual (only when clicking Speak), voice_only (when asked by voice), or always

entry.name: autoListenOnActivate
entry.label: Automatically start listening via microphone when Kity is activated with its shortcut

entry.name: vadEnabled
entry.label: Automatically stop recording when speech finishes

entry.name: vadSilenceTimeoutMs
entry.label: Milliseconds of silence after speech before automatically ending recording

entry.name: wakeWordEnabled
entry.label: Listen for wake word in background (e.g. 'Hola Kity' or 'Oye Kity')

entry.name: earconsEnabled
entry.label: Play Siri-style acoustic confirmation tones when starting and stopping voice listening

entry.name: defaultEmailClient
entry.label: Default email service for composing emails: proton or gmail

entry.name: defaultCalendarClient
entry.label: Default calendar service: korganizer, google or proton

entry.name: pin
entry.label: Keep the popup window open when focus moves to another window

entry.name: knowledgeBaseEnabled
entry.label: Enable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) from local knowledge documents

entry.name: knowledgeBaseMaxSnippets
entry.label: Maximum number of document snippets to inject as context
